sentences.text: D. If the opp. Parties do not show cause or shown insufficient cause then the rule NISI be made absolute.

And further be pleased to pass any other appropriate writ/writ(s), direction/direction(s) as would be deem fit and proper for the ends of justice;
And for which act of kindness, the petitioner shall as in duty bound ever pray."

3. In course of hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner states that highlighting her grievances, the petitioner has made a representation to opposite party no.3 vide Annexure-6 series and the same may be directed to be considered taking into consideration the order dated 03.10.2001 passed by this Court in OJC No. 12771 of 2001 and Annexure-8 within a stipulated time, to which learned counsel appearing for the State has no objection.
4.

As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the writ petition directing opposite party no.3 to consider the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-6 series,
and pass appropriate order taking into consideration order dated 03.10.2001 passed by this Court in OJC No. 12771 of 2001 and Annexure-8 in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
